answer.says: Ramesh, you are right to say it plainly. I have not the sum, and I will not pretend otherwise. But the system of needs is broken when the hand that feeds me is unpaid. I cannot pay you today, but I will go to the Directorate tomorrow morning to demand the release of the arrears from my imprest. Until then, I ask you to cook for me; I will settle your wage the moment the money is in my hand. Do not leave the house.
answer.thought: The tension is clear: the universal right to sustenance is blocked by the particular lack of coin. I must appeal to the administrative machinery to resolve the contradiction, but I cannot starve while the file moves at its own glacial pace. I will assert my claim to the state's funds, as is my right as the de facto holder of this post.
